name: Choice Band
shortEffect: Boosts Attack by 50%, but locks the holder into the first move it uses.
description: A high-risk physical damage item. Great for wallbreakers that can click one strong move safely.

name: Choice Specs
shortEffect: Boosts Sp. Atk by 50%, but locks the holder into the first move it uses.
description: The special-attacker version of Choice Band. Best on Pokémon with strong, reliable special attacks.

name: Choice Scarf
shortEffect: Boosts Speed by 50%, but locks the holder into the first move it uses.
description: Used to outspeed threats and revenge knockouts. The move lock is the tradeoff.

name: Life Orb
shortEffect: Boosts damaging moves by 30%; the holder loses HP after attacking.
description: Flexible power without being locked into one move. Best on attackers that value move freedom.

name: Leftovers
shortEffect: Restores a little HP at the end of every turn.
description: A simple, reliable recovery item for bulky Pokémon that stay on the field for several turns.

name: Black Sludge
shortEffect: Restores Poison-type Pokémon each turn; damages non-Poison holders.
description: Usually Leftovers for Poison-types, with a small punishment if tricked onto the wrong target.

name: Focus Sash
shortEffect: At full HP, lets the holder survive one potential knockout with 1 HP.
description: Excellent for fragile leads or setup Pokémon that must survive one hit to do their job.

name: Assault Vest
shortEffect: Boosts Sp. Def by 50%, but prevents status moves.
description: Turns attacking Pokémon into special tanks if they do not need non-damaging moves.

name: Heavy-Duty Boots
shortEffect: Prevents damage and effects from entry hazards when switching in.
description: One of the best consistency items for Pokémon weak to Stealth Rock or vulnerable to hazards.

name: Rocky Helmet
shortEffect: Damages attackers that make contact with the holder.
description: Punishes physical contact moves and helps bulky Pokémon wear down attackers.

name: Eviolite
shortEffect: Boosts Defense and Sp. Def if the holder can still evolve.
description: Makes some not-fully-evolved Pokémon surprisingly durable.

name: Expert Belt
shortEffect: Boosts super-effective moves without recoil or move lock.
description: Useful when a Pokémon has wide coverage and often hits for super-effective damage.

name: Muscle Band
shortEffect: Slightly boosts physical moves.
description: A small, no-drawback physical boost. Usually weaker than stronger specialized items.

name: Wise Glasses
shortEffect: Slightly boosts special moves.
description: A small, no-drawback special boost. Easy to understand, but not always optimal.

name: Sitrus Berry
shortEffect: Restores HP when the holder drops to half health or lower.
description: Good burst healing for bulky Pokémon, setup users, and doubles formats.

name: Lum Berry
shortEffect: Cures one major status condition or confusion.
description: Protects a key turn from burn, paralysis, sleep, poison, freeze, or confusion.

name: Mental Herb
shortEffect: Cures infatuation and several move-locking effects like Taunt once.
description: Useful for support Pokémon that must get one important status move off.

name: Air Balloon
shortEffect: Gives temporary Ground immunity until the holder is hit.
description: Lets Ground-weak Pokémon switch into Earthquake once if the balloon remains intact.

name: Light Clay
shortEffect: Extends Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil duration.
description: The standard item for dedicated screen setters.

name: Damp Rock
shortEffect: Extends rain created by the holder.
description: Used by rain setters to give rain attackers more turns to work.

name: Heat Rock
shortEffect: Extends harsh sunlight created by the holder.
description: Used by sun setters to support Fire damage and sun-based abilities.

name: Smooth Rock
shortEffect: Extends sandstorm created by the holder.
description: Useful for sand teams that need more turns of chip damage or ability support.

name: Icy Rock
shortEffect: Extends snow created by the holder.
description: Supports snow teams and Ice-type defensive plans.

name: Booster Energy
shortEffect: Activates Protosynthesis or Quark Drive once without matching terrain or weather.
description: A defining item for many Paradox Pokémon, boosting their highest eligible stat.

name: Clear Amulet
shortEffect: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering the holder's stats.
description: Useful against Intimidate and stat-dropping support.

name: Covert Cloak
shortEffect: Protects the holder from additional effects of damaging moves.
description: Blocks secondary effects like flinches and some stat drops from attacks.

name: Loaded Dice
shortEffect: Makes many multi-hit moves hit more times.
description: Key item for Pokémon relying on moves such as Bullet Seed, Icicle Spear, or Population Bomb.

name: Throat Spray
shortEffect: Raises Sp. Atk after the holder uses a sound-based move.
description: A one-time boost for special attackers that naturally use sound moves.

name: Weakness Policy
shortEffect: Sharply raises Attack and Sp. Atk after being hit super effectively.
description: High payoff on bulky Pokémon that can survive a super-effective hit.

name: Mirror Herb
shortEffect: Copies an opponent's stat increases once.
description: Punishes opposing setup and can create surprise momentum.

name: Flame Orb
shortEffect: Burns the holder after one turn.
description: Used with abilities or strategies that benefit from being burned, such as Guts.

name: Toxic Orb
shortEffect: Badly poisons the holder after one turn.
description: Used with Poison Heal or other status-based strategies.

name: Terrain Extender
shortEffect: Extends terrain created by the holder.
description: Supports teams built around Electric, Grassy, Psychic, or Misty Terrain.

name: Safety Goggles
shortEffect: Protects from powder moves and weather damage.
description: Helpful against Spore and weather chip, especially for support Pokémon.

name: Punching Glove
shortEffect: Boosts punching moves and prevents contact effects for those moves.
description: A specialized item for Pokémon using many punch-based attacks.
